regimeSub: SPX +0.4% as Treasuries rally on election-day flight to quality; 10Y drops 3bp to 4.91% amid equity rotation.
themes: Fed Musalem Oct 30 called for hikes 'soon' per Yahoo Finance; Warsh held at 4% Oct 28 FOMC with core PCE at 3.1% → Dec hike optionality intact despite Q3 GDP 3.4%
10Y yield falls 3bp to 4.91% as election-day haven flows per Bloomberg accelerate bond rally → 2s10s steepens to +32bp with 2Y up 3bp to 4.59% on hawkish Fed repricing
Lagarde ECB exit Feb 2027 per NYT leaves policy vacuum → EURUSD firms to 1.1254 as DXY weakens to 101.28; BOK Nov hike consensus per Korea Times supports won at 1340
Brent crashes 2.3% to $102.76 as Iran war premium fades and OPEC+ Dec targets hold per Reuters → gold +0.3% to $3,950 on election hedging; VIX stable at 20.83

headline: US Election Day triggers bond rally and equity rotation as Fed's Musalem reinforces Dec hike optionality with core PCE at 3.1% and Brent collapses below $103.
